x: He handed over 50 yds clear of Rushman (Oldbury) and O'Sullivan (Herne Hill H.) In fifth place was the Belgrave 'B' team, through an excellent effort by new member Tony Fairclough; and an unfit David Cocks brought the 'A' team home in 19th place.

This is always a high-class field and when runners like Cooke (Portsmouth), O'Sullivan (Oxford ),Franklin (Tipton), Hill-Cottingham (Chelms) and Snowden (Surrey) all finish in the thirties, it is decidedly tough.
